literal: Decorum excellence because-it-gives, decorum even-than-life to-protect will-be.
translation: Because decorum yields excellence, it must be guarded even more fiercely than life itself.
modern: ஒழுக்கம் ஒருவனுக்குச் சிறப்பைத் தருவதால், அந்த ஒழுக்கத்தை உயிரை விட மேலானதாகக் கருதிப் பாதுகாக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the supreme value of good conduct or decorum (ஒழுக்கம்). Because maintaining proper conduct brings true excellence and eminence (விழுப்பம்) to a person, it is the most valuable trait one can possess. Therefore, the text argues that decorum must be guarded (ஓம்பப்படும்) even more fiercely than one's own life (உயிரினும்). While life is naturally precious, the excellence born of good conduct makes it worth more than mere survival.
